config.split_assignment: 12 train,4development,4evaluation whole families fixed before forward. Related domains cross splits; not a claim of unseen primitives.
config.gate: Per family at least4 token-valid equal-length pairs, >=75% both-endpoint binary accuracy, >=50% intended full-vocabulary top1. Training eligibility determined only by train cohort.
config.answer_policy: Single-token exact continuation groups for original/capitalized/uppercase answer. Alternatives not listed can make open-vocabulary accuracy conservative.
config.historical_scope: New candidate prompts for current five-family training expansion; some task types/lexical items were studied previously. No claim of globally novel tasks.
config.evaluation_scope: Native competence screened on all splits; evaluation prompts thus opened for competence, not untouched. No representation fitted or selected.
config.alignment: Equal token lengths permit positionwise patching but do not prove semantic alignment.
